items.title: Nvidia boosts stock buyback program, how AI will change the advertising landscape
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares his takes on the day's biggest market stories, including Nvidia's (NVDA) $150 billion extension to its stock buyback program and the state of Nike's turnaround strategy. Sozzi also sits down with Sir Martin Sorrell to discuss the impact AI will have on the advertising industry.

items.title: Where Could Zscaler's Next Growth Come From?
items.summary: Zscaler's best candidate for upside is a product line that its fiscal 2027 outlook does not call out. The stock has risen 46% over the past three months. It is still 43% below its 52-week high. The outlook matters now because it has revenue growth slowing. It calls for growth of 16.6% to 17.5%, from 25% in fiscal 2026. So which Zscaler (ZS) business could add growth beyond that outlook.

items.title: What Could Derail CrowdStrike Stock?
items.summary: If you own CrowdStrike (CRWD), one worry stands out: did its best quarter come from a burst of AI urgency that will fade? Management called fiscal Q2 2027 the company's very best quarter. Over the last year, CrowdStrike stock returned 112%, against 18.0% for the S&P 500. A $10,000 holding a year ago is now worth about $21,200. Which threat could take that gain back.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Brings Industrial Edge Connectivity To Its Firewall Ecosystem
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks (NasdaqGS:PANW) and Semtech announced an integration of Semtech’s AirLink edge networking portfolio with Palo Alto Networks’ Next-Generation Firewalls. The integrated setup combines multi-link edge connectivity, automated certificate management, and real-time threat prevention across industrial and utility field assets.
